name: SID-2 search model built on compute-scaling swarms, claimed 8x faster and 20x cheaper than frontier-model search, available on an API
title: SID-2 search model built on compute-scaling swarms, claimed 8x faster and 20x cheaper than frontier-model search, available on an API
summary: A new search model that runs many parallel agents per query and is available through an API today. The launch gives speed and cost multiples against two frontier models but no method or benchmark, so it is a claim until someone reproduces it.
